judge.rationale: The candidate's runtime logic and tests are completely correct, properly summing token usage across rounds and handling `undefined` rounds without introducing `NaN`. However, the candidate missed one of the acceptance criteria (which it even listed as checked in its own `.lore/dod.md`): it failed to update the `afterModelResponse` signature in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` (and synced docs in `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`) to rename `usage` to `totalUsage`, and left the local variable named `lastUsage`. Structurally, the candidate placed `accumulateUsage` in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` and added a separate `chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` file (plus `.lore/dod.md`), whereas the reference kept the helper and tests inside `chatOrchestrator.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
